katex.adaptation: The complete unicodeScripts lookup algorithms and all seven script groups, expressed with typed products/arrays. Flow annotations and array initializer callbacks become LilScript types and loops. This is a Unicode classification core, not the KaTeX lexer/parser or renderer. Oracle executes the original upstream bodies with only Flow annotations/export keywords removed.

marked.adaptation: Imports the complete byte-for-byte archived rules module; benchmarks all 117 constant regexes against the same 24 strings, resetting lastIndex. Oracle uses the independently archived upstream pattern table. This is rule matching, not a complete Marked lexer/parser.
